text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — spike detected: org=midnight-bridge, qps > 8x baseline, 5xxs rising. Auto-rate-limit kicked in for org; customers seeing degraded responses.
Maya: I'm on it, paging SRE. On-call handoff to me.
Tom: oncall ack. Can you dump recent metrics?
Maya: pasted heatmap from dashboard, qps -> 9200 (p95 requests/sec), error rate 502-> 4.8% last 5m. Burst started at 1912345400.
Ricardo: is this traffic coming from a single API key/org? Any bot traffic pattern?
Maya: looks org-scoped (midnight-bridge). IP set shows ~120 unique IPs, pattern is steady high tail latencies on streaming endpoints.
Anna (CS): just got an inbound from their account team — they're seeing timeouts in two customer regions. They asked for immediate relief.
Maya: proposal: temporary, narrow mitigation — raise org-level (soft) qps cap to allow business flows to complete while we investigate root cause. Also enable aggressive prefix caching for their most common prompt. Set an automatic rollback in 60m.
Tom: I can apply a quick org override. Plan: bump qps cap from 2000 -> 7000 for 30 minutes, enable route-shaping for low-priority bulk endpoints to 20% capacity, and put a short-lived customer feature flag disable for non-essential streaming debug endpoints.
Maya: please run the admin command and paste the output. Keep changes scoped to org id midnight-bridge.
Tom: running:
```
# internal admin CLI
rwd-admin org update-quota --org midnight-bridge --qps 7000 --window 30m --reason "emergency surge - mitigate timeouts"
```
Tom: CLI output: "SUCCESS: quota override applied (id=oq_2026_911), expires=1912347378"
DeployBot: Deploy event: quota-override oq_2026_911 created by Tom at 1912345720 — propagated to edge in 6s.
Ricardo: confirm that fallback model variants are available if latency persists? We should set routing fallback to cheaper/shorter models for latency-sensitive routes.
Maya: yup, added a canary route: prefer gpt-ec-lowlat for chat for this org. Route policy hash applied.
Tom: also applied route-shape: `low-priority-endpoints=20%` and disabled `stream-debug-v2` via feature flag `ff:midnight-stream-debug=false` for the org. Command: `rwd-admin feature set --org midnight-bridge --flag mid-stream-debug --value false`
Maya: Anna — can you notify the AE + ops contact on their side with the mitigation note and expected rollback time? Also ask them to pause any bulk job runs.
Anna (CS): sending a quick note now: "We rolled a temporary quota increase and disabled non-essential streaming debug. Expect service to normalize within 5-10m. Will auto-rollback in 30m. Ping me if anything changes"
Ricardo: monitoring tip — watch regen latency and invalid-token-rate. If we see auth storms, revert to org hard cap and engage customer.
Tom: quick smoke: p95 latency dropped from 1.8s -> 420ms after override; 502s dropping to 0.9%.
Maya: good. Setting alert thresholds: page if 502s > 2% sustained for 2m or qps > 10k for 3m.
DeployBot: Alert rule updated by Maya: incident->org:midnight-bridge thresholds set.
Ricardo: note — create a follow-up ticket to investigate source of surge and to propose quota policy changes (rate-limiter smoothing, token bucket warmup). I'm creating ENG-INV-5423.
Maya: created ENG-INV-5423 — assigned to Ricardo, high priority, due EOD.
Anna (CS): customer replied: "Thanks, that helped — most flows back to normal but we have one backend batch job queued. We'll keep it paused."
Tom: capturing final state: quota-override oq_2026_911 active, routes switched to lowlat canary, stream-debug disabled. Auto-rollback scheduled at 1912347378.
Maya: leaving this thread open for the handoff to oncall at the 30m mark. If rollback triggers and errors spike, escalate to exec-SRE.
Ricardo: thumbs up. After-action notes: keep org-specific shields small and temporary. We'll run postmortem after ENG-INV-5423 triage.
Maya: closing the active mitigation window; monitoring 10m. If stable, I'll mark resolved in 1912349100.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident annotated: type=org_quota_override, org=midnight-bridge, mitigation=quota_bump+route_shaping+feature_disable, exec_id=oq_2026_911
